_about: The setup wizard's questions and the gear HouseOS supports. Each option says how it is set up: 'ha' = HouseOS runs that integration's own setup inside Home Assistant (HA asks its questions, HouseOS shows them); 'ha-ui' = needs a sign-in page that only Home Assistant can show (OAuth), so HouseOS opens it there; 'direct' = HouseOS talks to it itself; 'guide' = instructions only. Add gear here - no code needed for an 'ha' option.

steps.title: Home Assistant
steps.intro: HouseOS uses Home Assistant to talk to your lights, locks, sensors, cameras and power company. Everything you pick in the next steps is set up inside Home Assistant for you.

guides.install-ha:
Home Assistant runs well in Docker on the same machine as HouseOS:

  docker run -d --name homeassistant --restart unless-stopped --network host -v /path/to/ha-config:/config ghcr.io/home-assistant/home-assistant:stable

Open http://<that machine>:8123, create your account, then come back and choose 'Yes'. Or buy a Home Assistant Green - it works out of the box.
guides.wyze: Wyze cameras work through docker-wyze-bridge, which turns them into normal streams. Install it, then pick 'Frigate' or 'Other IP camera'.
guides.cloud-cams: Arlo and Eufy are cloud cameras. Add them in Home Assistant with the community integrations (HACS); HouseOS shows them once they're there.
guides.already-in-ha: Anything already in Home Assistant shows up in HouseOS automatically - nothing else to do.
guides.emporia: Emporia Vue works through a community integration (HACS). Add it in Home Assistant; HouseOS reads it from there.
